description: `serve.json: {"trailingSlash": false, "cleanUrls": false}` → paths ending in `/` get a 301 to the stripped form. `cleanUrls` is explicitly disabled so the cleanUrls 301 (Stage 6c) cannot mask or compose with the trailingSlash redirect. The anti-redirect anchor uses `/about.html` (no trailing slash, file with extension served directly) to verify phase 5 does not fire when it should not. The double-slash anchor verifies the multi-slash override (`serve-handler/src/index.js:158-160`): when trailingSlash is set and the path contains `//`, the redirect target is the slash-collapsed form (NOT the strip-target) — confirms `/test//` → `/test/`, not `/test`. Backs SRV-ROUT-004 and SRV-ROUT-005.
